title: Accessory, isolated, strict front (hat, weapon, bag, cape, jewellery)
description: One separable accessory shown front-orthographic as it would sit on the character, no character wearing it.

body.subject: Reference the attached strict-front A-pose character sheet. Render ONLY the {{item}} from the character, isolated on a white background, as a standalone object: {{kind_hint}}.
body.action: Shown front-face to the camera, oriented as it would sit on the front-facing character in the A-pose; full length visible.
body.camera: STRICT FRONT VIEW, front-orthographic like a technical reference; no three-quarter hero angle, no showcase shot.
body.style: Neutral flat lighting; same material, hardware, finish, pattern, wear and patina as the sheet; sharp focus at 2K.
body.constraints: No character wearing it; nothing else in the frame.

item.default: the item named in the parts list
item.description: the item with its descriptor, e.g. wide-brimmed wizard hat with a star-pattern band

kind_hint.description: hat: brim and crown as they read dead-on; weapon: blade-front, full length; bag: hanging as on the front-facing pose; cape: draped; jewelry: close macro

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting

provenance.note: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Mr. Mak Workspace contributors); the wording is adapted to Lampway's five-part body and its five-negative cap (the upstream negative list is shipped as the long-negative variant where it is a tuning question)

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: verify the view with lampway_view_verify; a stop after the ladder's ceiling is the user's decision
